answer: Farming becomes a nectar bet on surviving 84 epochs of grading, and every harbor settlement recomputes the lotus schedule, so a hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 16 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 84 epochs rather than arriving at once. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
